title: Fully plant-derived flaxseed mucilage-soy protein inks for extrusion-based 3D printing of tunable hydrogel scaffolds
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26789-26804
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00817H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pooja Kumari, Rishabh Rai Kaushik, Snehlata Yadav, Sanjeev Kumar Mahto
The flax seed mucilage/soy protein isolate-based hydrogel inks enabled the extrusion-based 3D printing of porous scaffolds that exhibited excellent printability, structural stability, and adjustable swelling and mechanical properties.
